description:
CROSS-REPO — owned and built in AGORA (downstream validator obligations), not koine. Delivers a validator behavior the specs REQUIRE but koine deliberately does not hold (ADR-0001): a bare projection arriving WITHOUT its manifest is not a unit of transfer, so the validator must REFUSE it (schemas/README.md). koine holds the schema shape; the validator runtime is downstream. Tracked here as a koine ROADMAP Phase F5 marker ('agora chief/65-manifestless-pack-rejection'). PARKED in koine: placeholder; move to agora/tasks/chief/ to activate.

DOWNSTREAM COUNTERPART (authored 2026-08-19): agora:78-manifestless-pack-rejection. This record is the marker, not the work. Retire it with supersededBy naming that tasklist once it merges — nothing in chief does this automatically.
warmup: echo 'Cross-repo: implement in agora against koine schemas/README.md + grounding-pack contract'

userStories.title: Reject a manifest-less pack (schemas/README.md)
userStories.description: In agora / the shared-validator repo, implement the rule that a bare projection without its manifest is not a unit of transfer and must be refused. koine ROADMAP marker; downstream per ADR-0001.
acceptanceCriteria: Implemented downstream (not koine): the validator refuses a bare projection that arrives without its manifest — a manifest-less pack is not a unit of transfer (schemas/README.md) — with a clear rejection, and accepts the same projection when accompanied by its manifest.
The behavior conforms to koine's KGP contract and schema by reference (ADR-0001); koine holds the shape, agora holds the enforcing validator.
Runs under agora's own gates; no koine file is edited by this tasklist.
userStories.notes: Cross-repo (agora). Parked in koine as a ROADMAP F5 marker.

Verified before filing that no tasklist in any repo depends on this stem, since a completed record without mergedToMain blocks dependents permanently.
